description: Figure 2 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating an accuracy comparison of different models on paraphrase, sentiment, and STS tasks. The horizontal category axis displays five distinct models in the following order from left to right: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy / Correlation" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. Light gray horizontal grid lines extend across the chart from each tick mark. The chart features grouped bars, where each model category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three adjacent bars. According to the legend positioned at the top center, these bars represent three metrics: "Sentiment Acc." (colored light pink), "STS Corr." (colored light orange), and "Paraphrase Acc." (colored light blue), arranged in that order from left to right within each group. Across the chart, the values for Sentiment Acc. remain relatively consistent at approximately 0.5 for all models. The Paraphrase Acc. values are also relatively stable, hovering between approximately 0.75 and 0.78. The STS Corr. values show the most variation, containing both the shortest bar in the chart at approximately 0.45 for the Single-task_baseline model, and the tallest bar in the chart at approximately 0.82 for the 2-Tier SimCSE model. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted by ascending or descending bar height, and none of the bars feature visual emphasis such as bolding, outlines, or annotations.
